description: Prove that the Argos CLI Tool Client matches standard log levels case-insensitively while preserving the same live log identity.

dynamic_inputs.name: observed_level
dynamic_inputs.selector: select the newest log whose _level lowercases to one of fixed_inputs.standard_levels and whose __logid is non-empty
requirements: is not copied into committed evidence

dynamic_inputs.name: lower_level
dynamic_inputs.selector: lowercase observed_level without changing its semantic family

dynamic_inputs.name: log_id
dynamic_inputs.selector: take __logid from the same selected log as observed_level
requirements: belongs to the selected PSM and time window
redacted from committed and shared evidence

steps.purpose: Check the live Tool schema before exercising the behavior.
success: level is an array of strings

steps.purpose: Discover a current standard-level log and a provenance-linked LogID.
success: the CLI and MCP envelopes are successful
at least one log has a non-empty __logid and a standard _level value
the selected log belongs to the fixed PSM, region, and window

steps.purpose: Establish the exact-casing baseline for the selected log.
success: the CLI and MCP envelopes are successful
the response contains the selected log_id with _level equal to observed_level

steps.purpose: Verify that lowercase standard input resolves to the same live log.
success: the CLI and MCP envelopes are successful
the response contains the same selected log_id and preserves its stored _level casing

assertions: Reject CLI status=error, JSON-RPC errors, MCP isError, permission errors, and Tool-not-found responses.
The exact-casing and lowercase calls both return the same dynamically discovered log_id.
The lowercase call does not rewrite the _level value stored in the returned log.
An empty discovery result is inconclusive, not a pass.
